chapter: Name, boyhood and early New Orleans
title: Name change from Zeno to George Lewis, Storyville clubs and early New Orleans musicians
summary: Lewis explains how he came to be called George and legally changed his name in the 1940s, then names the Storyville-area places he played and the older musicians he knew as a child, including Manuel Perez and segregation among bands.
